title: armeria alpina subsp. trachyphylla
intro: Armeria alpina subsp. trachyphylla, commonly known as Alpine Bearberry or Bearberry Thyme, is a plant species that belongs to the Plumbaginaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have several health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health and act as an antioxidant, reducing inflammation and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Armeria alpina subsp. trachyphylla include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
